units.text: INT. COUNTY COURTHOUSE - COURTROOM 3B - DAY
A cramped room under a failing skylight.
Radiators clank.
JUDGE IMELDA CARDENAS, sixties, silver braid, presides.
WENDELL PRATT, fifties, rumpled prosecutor.
SOO-JIN HAN, thirties, sharp defense counsel in a navy suit.
In the box, BARTHOLOMEW "BARTY" QUILL, seventies, a retired beekeeper in a borrowed tie.
Mr. Quill, you've kept bees how long?
units.name: SOO-JIN

units.text: Fifty-one years, Ms. Han.
units.name: BARTY

units.text: Objection. Relevance.
units.name: WENDELL

units.text: Mr. Pratt, you've been relevant to nothing since lunch. Overruled.
units.name: JUDGE CARDENAS

units.text: Your Honor, with respect--
units.name: WENDELL

units.text: I said overruled, Wendell.
units.name: JUDGE CARDENAS

units.text: Mr. Quill, on the night of the fourteenth, you saw a van near the apiary.
units.name: SOO-JIN

units.text: Gray van. No plates. Engine running.
units.name: BARTY

units.text: Leading!
units.name: WENDELL

units.text: He's describing, Your Honor.
units.name: SOO-JIN

units.text: He is describing. Sit, Mr. Pratt.
units.name: JUDGE CARDENAS

units.text: I am sitting, Judge.
units.name: WENDELL

units.text: You are hovering. Sit lower.
units.name: JUDGE CARDENAS

units.text: Can I say something about the bees?
units.name: BARTY

units.text: Please, Barty.
units.name: SOO-JIN

units.text: Mr. Quill, you don't have to--
units.name: WENDELL

units.text: I want to. They go quiet when strangers come. That night, they went quiet at ten, not nine. Somebody was at the hive an hour before the van.
units.name: BARTY

units.text: An hour before.
units.name: SOO-JIN

units.text: Right, Ms. Han. Which means the van wasn't the first.
units.name: BARTY

units.text: That's speculation.
units.name: WENDELL

units.text: It's beekeeping, Wendell, and it's more than you've given me all week.
units.name: JUDGE CARDENAS

units.text: Mr. Quill, who else keeps hives within a mile?
units.name: SOO-JIN

units.text: Just the Pellegrino boy and me.
units.name: BARTY

units.text: Your Honor, this is a fishing expedition.
units.name: WENDELL

units.text: It is a honey expedition, and I'll allow it.
units.name: JUDGE CARDENAS

units.text: And the Pellegrino boy, Barty, does he drive a gray van?
units.name: SOO-JIN

units.text: He drives a bicycle.
units.name: BARTY

units.text: Thank you!
units.name: WENDELL

units.text: But his uncle drives a gray van.
units.name: BARTY

units.text: Objection!
units.name: WENDELL

units.text: Overruled. Go on, Mr. Quill.
units.name: JUDGE CARDENAS

units.text: Uncle Dario. Owes me forty dollars since March.
units.name: BARTY

units.text: Nothing further, Your Honor.
units.name: SOO-JIN

units.text: Mr. Pratt, cross?
units.name: JUDGE CARDENAS

units.text: Mr. Quill, about that forty dollars.
units.name: WENDELL

units.text: Yes, Mr. Pratt?
units.name: BARTY

units.text: You hold a grudge, don't you?
units.name: WENDELL

units.text: I hold bees, Mr. Pratt. Grudges just sting.
units.name: BARTY

units.text: Court is in recess until two. Ms. Han, bring me honey.
units.name: JUDGE CARDENAS

units.text: Your Honor?
units.name: SOO-JIN

units.text: Jar of it. My cold's back.
units.name: JUDGE CARDENAS
